rawResults.Title: State of the Art Speech Recognition with MAI-Transcribe-1
rawResults.Snippet: Apr 2, 2026Benchmarks are only part of the story. When it comes to production use cases such as voice agents, meeting transcription, and call center analytics, audio is rarely clean. MAI-Transcribe-1 was built with challenging recording conditions in mind, reliably handling background noise, low-quality audio recordings, and overlapping speech.

rawResults.Title: MAI-Transcribe-1.5: 43-Language Speech-to-Text with Keyword Biasing ...
rawResults.Snippet: 3 days agoMicrosoft's MAI-Transcribe-1.5, announced as part of a seven-model MAI launch at Build 2026, is specifically designed to address this. Its headline features are 43-language support and keyword biasing — a mechanism that lets you supply domain-specific vocabulary at inference time so the model actively favours those terms during recognition.
